note: Provenance of every runtime asset embedded by src/kernels/shared/runtime_asset.rs. status: verbatim = byte-identical to upstreamCommit; patched = upstreamCommit plus the described mhc change; local = mhc-only; unported = exists upstream, not shipped; "reason" says why.
